notes: the two isnads are both written in full (the second after «ح»): two groups, no shared tail
«مولى أبي قتادة» is the patronymic of نافع, not a link; «أبي محمد، نافع» is one man (rule 7); the second route's bare «أبي محمد» is not merged with him
«قال لنا عمرو اذهبوا إلى صالح» is a remark inside the saying with no transmission: left out
